from app.api.handlers import handle_user_report

def test_user_report_ok():
    status, report = handle_user_report({"name": "test-name_123"})
    assert status == 200
    assert report["name"] == "test-name_123"

def test_user_report_invalid_name():
    assert handle_user_report({"name": "invalid!"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
    assert handle_user_report({"name": ""}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
    assert handle_user_report({"name": "a"*33}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})

def test_user_report_missing_name():
    assert handle_user_report({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
